hybrid.error.streamUnsupported: This service does not support streaming. Turn off Online streaming response in Hybrid mode.
hybrid.adaptiveHelp: Used in Bilibili hybrid mode. Uses recent measured latency to estimate whether local tasks can finish on time and adjusts when online tasks are combined. If local work is expected to miss its deadline, new tasks go to the online service. It never changes or exceeds your local per-5-second caps for item count, characters, or concurrency. When off, routing still follows the fixed caps.
hybrid.onlineStreamingHelp: Used for online routing in Bilibili hybrid mode. Each complete, valid translation is sent to danmaku scheduling as soon as it is ready, without waiting for the whole batch. Danmaku still appears at its playback time; text is not shown token by token. The online service must support streaming. If prompted that it is unsupported, turn this off.
settings.bilibiliOwnedReleaseHint: Plan ordinary danmaku 5 seconds ahead to reduce translation volume; skip missing translations. Uses your current translation service and native blocking, tracks and speed settings without controlling video playback.
settings.bilibiliNativeTranslationOnlyHi: Ordinary text without a translation is hidden; recognized target-language text and emoji remain. Start a budgeted local experiment; incompatible playback is paused.
